headline: This law makes Medicare cover eye-tracking accessories for speech-generating devices for people who medically need them, with uncapped payments for devices furnished in a set window.
what_it_does: The law amends the Medicare program to treat eye tracking and gaze interaction accessories for speech-generating devices as durable medical equipment. Coverage applies to people who have a demonstrated medical need for them. For devices furnished from October 1, 2015 through October 1, 2018, Medicare payment may be made on a rental basis or as a lump-sum purchase, and the payment has no dollar cap.

who_it_affects.group: Medicare beneficiaries who need speech-generating devices
who_it_affects.how: They can have eye-tracking and gaze interaction accessories covered by Medicare if they have a demonstrated medical need for them.

who_it_affects.group: Medicare beneficiaries who use speech-generating devices during the 2015 to 2018 window
who_it_affects.how: Payment for these devices and accessories may be made as a rental or lump sum with no cap on the amount for devices furnished in that period.

who_it_affects.group: Suppliers of durable medical equipment and speech-generating devices
who_it_affects.how: They can bill Medicare for eye-tracking and gaze interaction accessories under the rules for durable medical equipment.

when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted July 30, 2015. The no-cap payment rule applies to devices furnished on or after October 1, 2015 and before October 1, 2018.
